name: codex-continuity
description: Reuse existing Codex context, route durable work into the smallest fitting native container, and maintain task progress without a second task system.

interface.shortDescription: Reuse existing context without adding a second task system.
interface.longDescription: With a reliable project directory, check the first prompt once for one unique, high-confidence Codex task to continue, then route the original durable goal when no match is found. Without a project directory, skip cross-task reads and title maintenance and apply only the quiet work router. For each later durable goal, quietly use the current Codex model to choose the smallest fitting native path: stay in the current task, recommend or dispatch a subagent when authorized, suggest a persistent branch, or suggest a separate task. Current-task and low-confidence decisions stay silent; persistent task changes require confirmation. After reliable current-task work enters a new chapter or clearly changes its durable workstream, use the current Codex host to refresh the native title while the Stop Hook records traceable progress and a conservative fallback.
defaultPrompt: Check whether an existing Codex task already matches my new goal.
Show the latest reliable progress for this task.
Quietly route this new durable goal into the smallest fitting Codex path.
